text:
maria: Quick availability check — planning a nightly benchmark run tonight 22:00→04:00 UTC in eu-west1. Need ~8 A100s or 4 H100s. Any quota/standby we can tap? /cc @kyle-procurement

jin: We have 4 reserved A100s in eu-west1 for dedicated; spare pool currently shows 2 free. Requesting extra will be slow unless procurement can soft-hold.

rafael: Can we lean on preemptible H100s as a fallback? cheaper but preemptions could mess the benchmark.

maria: Prefer A100 to keep perf parity with baseline. Fallback to H100 preemptible is fine if we can chain fallback and note preemptions in the run.

kyle-procurement: I can try to create a soft hold on 4 A100s for tonight, but need quick approval from billing. pinging @priya for sign-off.

priya: approve up to $1k for an unplanned overnight bench. go ahead with soft-hold.

kyle-procurement: Filed a request with the vendor — ETA ~45m. reservation id: RES-1769-euA100-OVRN. Will update in thread.

ops-bot: snapshot: eu-west1 pool free: A100=2, H100-preemptible=12. Upcoming vendor maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC (may affect H100s).

maria: 2 free won't cut it. If the reservation misses the window, plan B is to split shards across us-west2 + eu-west1 and reduce batch size.

jin: splitting across regions adds ~30% network overhead — that'll skew long-tail latency numbers for the benchmark.

rafael: alternative — run a smaller smoke tonight to validate infra config, and full benchmark tomorrow once capacity is confirmed.

maria: fine, let's do smoke tonight. Also, can someone paste a quota/reservation request template I can reuse? I'll ping infra support if needed.

jin: use this quick template: 
```
gcloud compute reservations create bench-res --region=europe-west1 --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=4
```
then include the reservation id and account ref when you ping procurement.

maria: thanks. @kyle-procurement can you update when reservation is in or vendor rejects?

kyle-procurement: Vendor accepted a soft-hold for 4 A100s for 22:00. They asked for account ref: ACCT-9921. Reservation pending until funds clear.

procurement-bot: reservation RES-1769-euA100-OVRN status=pending_funds -> funded (tx 0x9f3a).

ops-bot: reservation confirmed. eu-west1 A100s allocated=4 for project/redwood-bench 22:00→04:00 UTC.

maria: awesome, thanks all. Quick checklist before 22:00: 1) bake images, 2) kv-cache warmup script, 3) trace config. I'll post a short runbook in a bit.

jin: I'll drop a PR to pin batch-size and rerun configs. ping me if you want canary metrics.

rafael: leaving a short kv warmup snippet:
```
for s in $(seq 0 7); do curl -X POST http://cache:8080/warm --data '{"seed':"$s"}'; done
```

maria: perfect. If anything changes ping #eng-infra with 'bench:fail' so oncall sees it.

kyle-procurement: closing loop — reservation now live and funded. Vendor also said we can extend by 2h on-demand if we overrun.

maria: noted. Thanks everyone :tada:
